messages:
Maya (CS): Quick capture from three onboarding calls today — customers keep asking for (1) per-route cost breakdown in Console (examples: 'Why is chat so expensive vs embeddings?'), (2) embedding freshness controls / purge TTL for per-route caching, and (3) SSO/client cred flow for private deployments. Sharing short notes + urgency.

Tom (PM): Thanks — can you paste the short customer quotes and which accounts? We need input to score on renewal impact.

Maya (CS): Sure — quotes: "We can't explain to finance why per-route spikes happen" (NorthBay), "embeddings get stale after deploys, search results degrade" (Velociti), "we need automated key rotation with our KMS" (BrightSpark). NorthBay is at 60% renewal risk, Velociti is fine but uses a lot of embeddings, BrightSpark asked for private with HSM — high-touch.

Priya (Product Ops): Suggest triage: impact (revenue/renewal risk), frequency (how many customers), complexity (eng estimate). Quick score idea: NorthBay = Impact 8 / Frequency 4 / Complexity 3 => candidate for small UX + cost-reporting sprint. Velociti = Impact 6 / Frequency 6 / Complexity 5 => medium. BrightSpark = Impact 7 / Frequency 2 / Complexity 8 => enterprise feature (sales + security).

Jules (Eng): @Tom FYI — per-route cost UI is mostly frontend + aggregated tokens endpoint. Backend work ~2w + 1w frontend. Embedding TTL: infra + model-serving cache flags, ~3w. Auth/key rotation depends on KMS integration (security) — might need design doc. :thinking_face: 

Tom (PM): OK — can someone create three tickets with the score table and attach any customer transcripts? I'll do priority and roadmap mapping. @Maya can you upload transcripts and add which customers are on Dedicated vs Hosted?

Maya (CS): Uploaded transcripts to the thread: https://redwood.docs/notes/1790012345. NorthBay = Hosted trial, Velociti = Dedicated, BrightSpark = Private. Adding a short note to each ticket.

onboard-bot: New transcript uploaded by Maya (CS) — 1 file. :page_facing_up:

Priya (Product Ops): I'll draft the triage board card and ping engineering for quick estimate review. :thumbsup:

Jules (Eng): I'll put estimates on the tickets tomorrow morning. :eyes:
